experiment: SG-threshold: label-free per-image threshold rules on SG-combined-v3 maps (CPU only)
source: outputs/segmentation/controlled_attention_cv/sg_combined_v3 counts (raw and R2, 17-point grid) and fp16 min-max 64x64 dense maps; no generation

rules.T0: global threshold, slot j = grid threshold t_j (registered rule)
rules.T2: two-Gaussian EM from the Otsu split; crossing of weighted densities between the means, Otsu if none; parameter-free
rules.T3: tau = mean + k std of the map, k = -1.00..3.00 step 0.25 (fold-selected)
rules.T4: most stable threshold: interior grid t_j minimising A(t_{j-1}) - A(t_{j+1}), A = map area >= t; ties to nearest 0.45; parameter-free
rules.T5: R1 only: keep R1's top pixels with the area of R0 >= t_j; t_j fold-selected

snapping: tau_I to the nearest grid threshold 0.30..0.70; R2 counts are read at the same snapped tau_I; grid-edge share reported
selection: unchanged registered selector on five frozen VOC folds, raw and R2 separately, reference R0.T0 (= v3 R0, FINE-P2) with all 12 other same-stage cells as candidates (inclusiveness equal); parameter slots chosen like thresholds; full-VOC slot frozen for COCO

decision_rules.promotion: a cell frozen by the R2 selector is a registered promotion over R0+R2 (the raw selector is reported alongside)
decision_rules.threshold_effect: a rule helps a map if it beats the same map's T0 in >=4/5 folds with paired interval above zero (raw or R2)
decision_rules.sheep: reported for every cell; the class guard is unchanged

diagnostics: per-image best-grid ceiling for R0/R1, sheep and worst class, GT-area bins vs reference, selected parameter, grid-edge share, map/count alignment; diagnostic only
